verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a CLI command that starts an OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC endpoints, and an official Docker image for running that server. That makes network-accessible model serving its core use case, and community users confirm they consume it through the OpenAI-compatible API. missing for 10: explicit documentation of host/port binding for LAN access (e.g. listening beyond localhost), guidance on authentication or securing access from other devices, and hands-on corroboration of multi-device access.
